title: The Moon's shadow raced across the heart of Spain, and I was there to see it
summary: I crossed paths with far more seasoned eclipse chasers in Spain, one boasting as many as 20 trips into totality. Anyone planning a trip to see a total solar eclipse needs to keep several things in mind.
